evidence: ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/Terminal.app/Contents/Info.plist (document types session, settings, shell script, unix executable, folders; URL schemes telnet, ssh, x-man-page; Services New Terminal at Folder, Open man Page, Search man Page Index)
ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/Terminal.app/Contents/Resources/Base.lproj/MainMenu.nib (Bookmarks/Marks, Copy Special, Window 1-9, Terminal Help, Low Memory panel)
springboard/src/shell/terminal/ and the iosterm core (../iOSTerm/src: term.rs, parser.rs, mouse.rs, select.rs, search.rs, sshconfig.rs)

features.apple: Shell > New Tab (cmd+T)
features.note: Cmd+T opens a tab in the home folder; More menu opens one in the current folder.

features.apple: Shell > New Window (cmd+N), New Window with profile
features.note: One terminal per desktop window; no new-window action inside the app. Not started: Shell holds one tab set (Shell::term), so a second window needs that split first.
features.wire: Add TermKey::NewWindow to hwkeys.rs (cmd+N) that asks the shell to open a second Terminal window with its own tab set; terminal state (self.term) then needs a per-window TabSet instead of one on Shell.

features.feature: Tab strip with close buttons and Cmd+1..9
features.apple: tab bar, select tab, next/previous tab
features.note: Compact tab strip, close box, Cmd+1 to 9, next and previous tab shortcuts.

features.feature: Reorder tabs and move a tab to a new window
features.apple: Window > Move Tab to New Window, Move Tab Left/Right, drag tabs
features.note: More > Move tab left and Move tab right reorder the tab bar (the active tab and a split pair follow their sessions). Pressing a tab name and dragging it along the bar moves the tab. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Move Tab to New Window once multiple windows exist (see New window).

features.feature: Close tab, close other tabs, reopen closed
features.apple: Shell > Close Tab, Close Other Tabs
features.note: Close tab (cmd+W confirms while a job runs), Reopen Closed Tab and Close other tabs (names running programs first, a second choice closes). Close Other Tabs is in the desktop File menu. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.feature: Prompt before closing a running process
features.apple: Inspector Prompt before closing; close alert
features.note: Second Cmd+W confirms when the tab has a foreground job.

features.apple: Shell > New Command… (run a command in a new window)
features.note: Command panel runs the line through /bin/sh -c in a new tab that closes at exit.

features.apple: Shell > New Remote Connection: service list, server list, user, Connect
features.note: Connections panel from the SSH config with add/edit form and import; no Bonjour server browser, no telnet or user-name toggle.
features.wire: Add a discovered-servers list to the Connections panel from the dns_browse service browser (_ssh._tcp) and a telnet service row.

features.apple: CFBundleURLTypes ssh://, telnet://
features.note: The Terminal declares ssh and telnet (shell/defaultapps.rs:39); a link opens a new tab with ssh [-p port] [user@]host or telnet host [port] typed in, from validated words (no option injection). A tap on an ssh, telnet or x-man-page link in the output opens it in a new tab (termtouch.rs:238 picks the links). No server browser yet. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Offer the server browser (see New Remote Connection) from the links and the Connections panel.

features.feature: x-man-page URL and man page services
features.apple: x-man-page scheme; Open man Page, Search man Page Index services
features.note: The x-man-page scheme, More > Open man page for selection (man [section] name) and More > Search man pages for selection (man -k on the selected word) open a new tab. The Services entries are not added. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add the Services entries for the man page index.

features.apple: Services: New Terminal / New Tab at Folder, Files Open in Terminal
features.note: Services > New Terminal at Folder (the App menu Services list) opens a Terminal tab in the folder of the selection, or the folder of a selected file; the route is services_route.rs:72 and terminal_open_in_folder in terminal/launch.rs:217. Files Open in Terminal (files/menu.rs OpenInTerminal) was already built. Needs a check on Midget.
features.wire: Check Open in Terminal from a file and a folder, and the Services entry, on Midget.

features.feature: Open a .command or executable file in Terminal
features.apple: document types: shell script, unix-executable
features.note: No file association. Terminal already receives shell scripts (defaultapps.rs:39) but does not run the file they open with; the document path into the Terminal is not built.
features.wire: Run the opened file in a new tab through spawn_terminal_tab once the Terminal takes a document path.

features.apple: Shell > Save as Window Group, Open Window Group
features.note: Save window group asks for a name (More), and Open window group lists the saved groups: a tap opens one, the cross deletes it after a second tap. Each tab keeps its folder and the profile in use; a command in a tab is typed when the group opens, but saving does not record the command of a running program yet. Open window group at launch opens the newest group. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Record the running command of each tab when a group is saved.

features.apple: Settings > Profiles: Basic, Pro, Homebrew, Ocean, Novel, Red Sands, Silver Aerogel, Clear Dark/Light
features.note: More > Profiles lists every colour theme and profile with the one in use marked; a tap uses it in every tab, and Use at Launch makes it the profile a Terminal starts with (profiles.rs:45). Color theme still cycles. A profile text size, caret and opacity are not applied yet. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Apply each profile text size and caret, and its opacity (see Window background image and translucency).

features.feature: Profile editor: ANSI colours, bold, blink, text
features.apple: Profiles > Text: font, character and line spacing, ANSI colours, bright for bold, antialias, blinking text
features.note: More > Text and background colors takes the text and background colour in hex and keeps them as the Custom entry at the end of the Color theme cycle (kept in terminal.colors). Font, spacing, the ANSI palette and the bold and blink options are not editable. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add a font picker, character and line spacing steppers, ANSI palette wells and bold, bright and blink toggles stored per profile.

features.apple: Cursor: Block, Underline, Vertical bar; Blink cursor
features.note: Style and blink stored in prefs and applied to every tab.

features.feature: Text size: bigger, smaller, actual size
features.apple: View > Bigger, Smaller (cmd + / -)
features.note: Cmd+plus, Cmd+minus and actual size; zoom steps saved.

features.apple: Profiles > Window: background image, opacity, blur
features.note: Clear profile alpha exists in the table but the view paints opaque.
features.wire: Paint the profile alpha through the compositor in view.rs and add an image slot to the profile editor.

features.apple: Settings > General: shell, new windows open with profile, startup window group
features.note: Use at Launch (Profiles panel) sets the default profile, empty for the numbered theme. More > Startup command sets a command typed into the first tab at launch (startup.rs:52). Login shell and Open window group at launch are as before. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Multiple windows: each new window opens with the default profile (see New window).

features.apple: Edit > Find (panel with Ignore Case, Wrap Around, Not found), Find Next/Previous, Use Selection for Find
features.note: More and Edit menu rows Ignore Case and Wrap Around (saved in prefs). With Ignore Case off the match needs the same letter case; with Wrap Around off the search stops at the ends of the scrollback (find_with, next_match). Find Next and Previous and Use Selection for Find as before. The Find bar has no buttons for the two options yet. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add Ignore Case and Wrap Around toggles to the Find panel.

features.apple: Edit > Copy, Paste, Select All; paste selection, paste escaped text
features.note: Edit menu: Paste Escaped Text (Shift+Cmd+V, hwkeys.rs TermKey::PasteEscaped), Paste Selection, Search Web for Selection and Look Up Selection; More has the same rows. Paste Selection has no key equivalent yet. Paste turns newlines to spaces in panels only. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Give Paste Selection a key equivalent.

features.feature: Copy Special: plain text and without background colour
features.apple: Edit > Copy Special
features.note: Copy yields plain text only. The clipboard (render/src/clipboard.rs) holds text and images, no styled text, so Copy Special has nothing to carry colours with. Needs a rich pasteboard type first.
features.wire: Add rich copy (colour runs) to Term::selected_text variants and a Copy Special submenu.

features.apple: double click word, triple click line, option-drag rectangle
features.note: Long press drag, double and triple tap select; no rectangular selection.
features.wire: Add option+drag rectangular selection in termtouch.rs.

features.apple: View > Allow Mouse Reporting
features.note: A touch drag reports to a program that asked for drags (mode 1002 or 1003): the press goes where the finger landed, then each cell the finger enters, then the release. Taps and scrolling are as before for other programs. More > Allow mouse reporting turns it all off. Pointer movement without a button (mode 1003) is not reported yet. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Report pointer movement without a button (mode 1003) from pointer events.

features.apple: Terminal > Secure Keyboard Entry
features.note: Toggle keeps shell shortcuts out of the terminal, saved.

features.apple: Edit > Mark as Bookmark, Insert Bookmark, Jump to Previous/Next Mark, Marks menu
features.note: Prompt starts reported by the shell (OSC 133;A) and lines marked with Cmd+U get a green tick in the margin; Cmd+Up and Cmd+Down (Edit menu, More menu) scroll to the previous and next mark. Marks are kept until the scrollback is full. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Keep marks across a full scrollback (the iosterm core needs to report how many lines it dropped), name bookmarks and list them in a panel.

features.apple: scrollback limit, Clear Scrollback (cmd+K), Clear to Start
features.note: Clear Scrollback (cmd+K), Reset, Clear Screen (Ctrl+L), Save scrollback to Files.

features.apple: Shell > Export Text As…, Save Selected Text As…
features.note: More > Export scrollback as and Save selection as ask for the file name; Enter saves it in Files, and an existing name is numbered. The quick Save scrollback to Files and Save selection to Files rows stay. No location panel: the file goes to Files.
features.wire: Use the SDK save panel for the folder choice (Export Text As and Save Selected Text As).

features.apple: View > Split Pane
features.note: Two sessions side by side with a divider; close split.

features.feature: Show Inspector: title, process list, columns and rows
features.apple: Shell > Show Inspector (cmd+I): window title, running processes, size
features.note: The Processes panel has an Edit Title button (window.rs:170, opens the tab title field). Terminate, Force kill and the list are as before. Columns and rows are not editable yet. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add a Columns and Rows stepper to the Processes panel.

features.apple: Shell > Edit Title
features.note: More > Edit tab title names the active tab, and the Processes panel has an Edit Title button too; an empty title gives the automatic one back. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: Edit > Open URL, Look Up, Search the Web; command-click links
features.note: Look Up Selection (Edit menu and More) opens the Look Up popover for the selected word, through bifrost_ui look_up. Search the web and Open URL as before. Cmd+click on a link is not handled.
features.wire: Add Cmd+click on a link (pointer modifiers).

features.apple: View > Enter Full Screen, Show Tab Bar, Show All Tabs
features.note: View > Show All Tabs (and More) lists every open tab, and a tap shows it. Hide Tab Bar is not added yet. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add Hide Tab Bar and a tab overview with previews.

features.apple: AppleScript dictionary
features.note: state, read, resize and clear verbs over the control endpoint.

features.apple: Shell, Edit, View, Window, Help menus
features.note: The desktop menu bar carries More rows: File (New Command, Close Other Tabs, Save and Open Window Group), Edit (Paste Escaped Text, Paste Selection, Look Up, Find options, Export), View (Show All Tabs, Allow Mouse Reporting), Window (a row per tab) and Help (Terminal Help, in desktop_bar.rs:270). Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Publish Profiles, Startup Command and Login Shell as a Shell menu through the menu bar API.

features.apple: Help > Terminal Help
features.note: Help > Terminal Help opens the help page while the Terminal is in front; More has it too. Built on parity/team-d-terminal; not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: Low Memory panel: older scrollback discarded
features.note: Scrollback is capped by line count, not by memory pressure.
